author: Retro Game Corps
description:
We've got a lot of ARM-based Android handhelds out today, and new operating systems like Armada allow you to have a SteamOS experience on them. In this video I'll show you how to install ARM Linux on a handheld and demonstrate what kind of performance you can expect.

Armada OS: https://armadaos.dev/
ROCKNIX: https://rocknix.org/
GameNative: https://gamenative.app/
pocknix-os: https://github.com/shuuri-labs/pocknix-os

Top 20 Steam Deck games on GameNative: https://youtu.be/Q5v10lisr_o 

Recommended handhelds:
AYN Odin 3: https://tinyurl.com/RGC-Odin3
Retroid Pocket 6: https://tinyurl.com/Retroid-RGC
AYN Thor: https://tinyurl.com/ThorRGC
AYN Odin 2 Portal: https://tinyurl.com/RGCodin2Portal
